details.name: Finding the Number of Days Above the Average Temperature
details.description: Construct a program that reads a series of temperatures and reports the average temperature and the number of the days that are above the average. Assume that the input values could have a decimal point.

details.name: Displaying the Days That are Above 32 Degrees Fahrenheit
details.description: Construct a program that reads a series of temperatures and reports the days that are above 32 degrees Fahrenheit. Assume that the temperature values are in Fahrenheit. Also assume that input values could have a decimal point.
